name_input: Belt and Bearing House Pvt Ltd
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs table (slug: belt-and-bearing-house-private-limited) shows outbound rows: "2026-02-20 | BELT AND BEARING HOUSE PRIVATE LIMITED | BEARING AND MILL STORE | BALL BEARING MIX SIZE AS PER INVOICE- RAXAUL | INRXLB, India | Birgunj, NEPAL | 84821090 | 9850637" and "2026-01-21 | BELT AND BEARING HOUSE PRIVATE LIMITED | RADHA KRISHNA OVERSEAS | UCP BEARING (DETAILS AS PER INVOICE)- SONAULI LCS | INSNLB, India | Bhairawa, NEPAL | 84831099 | 8940959" and "2025-09-29 | BELT AND BEARING HOUSE PRIVATE LIMITED | BIRGUNJ | UC-213 F SEAL BBH | RAXAUL, India | NEPAL | 84831099 | 3673575". Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 239 Records detected"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (3 export rows to Nepal + 2 import rows from China), i.e. 5 of 239 shown.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found in any accessible source. ImportKey free view shows only customs rows; the 'Buyers' block lists Nepal-based counterparties (BIRGUNJ MUSKAN METAL UDOG, BEARING AND MILL STORE, R A INTERNATIONAL, RADHA KRISHNA OVERSEAS) with no Indian domestic buyer rows visible. GSTIN/turnover not public in the sources reachable.
note: Real cross-border shipments are documented, not merely claimed: three dated export bills of lading to Nepal (Birgunj 2026-02-20 BOL 9850637; Bhairawa 2026-01-21 BOL 8940959; Nepal 2025-09-29 BOL 3673575) plus two import rows from Qingdao, China (2025-11-28 BOL 7259596, HS 84821020; 2025-10-11 BOL 2023183). Declared HS 848210/848320 is broadly consistent with observed 84821090/84821020, but observed rows also include 84831099 (transmission shafts/cranks), so the HS set should be widened to 8482 + 8483 rather than treated as an error. Note the export lanes are all land-border LCS to Nepal (Raxaul/Sonauli), i.e. small-lot trading volumes, not sea exports. Role reads as trader/importer-distributor of Chinese bearings (Qingdao Full King Luck Trading, Shandong One Book) reselling into Nepal — consistent with 'trader', not manufacturer. Domestic Indian supply side is unverified: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found, so domestic_status = unknown, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in accessible sources, not estimated. Caveat on method: volza, eximpedia, trademo and importgenius all returned 403/JS-challenge, and DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), so the 239-record total could not be independently cross-checked against a second trade-data provider.
